turns.query: Build a quarterly panel with BIS total credit (loans and debt securities, all lenders) to non-bank borrowers in emerging-market and developing economies for USD, EUR, and JPY, plus the calendar-quarter arithmetic mean of daily OFR Financial Stress Index values. Compute each currency's quarter-over-quarter log growth times 100 using the immediately preceding calendar-quarter level from the full BIS series, then retain transformed observations from 2001-Q1 through 2024-Q4. Order the four variables USD growth, EUR growth, JPY growth, OFR FSI. Estimate an intercept-bearing unrestricted VAR(2) by equation-by-equation OLS. Estimate innovation covariance from the residual cross-product divided by the number of VAR regression observations, not residual degrees of freedom. Report panel and regression counts, companion spectral radius, 2-norm condition numbers of the intercept-and-lag design and innovation covariance, and the maximum absolute sample normal-equation moment. Explain the statistical status of the stationarity and conditioning diagnostics, discuss the material scope limitations of combining the four series in one fitted system, and carry the VAR and innovation covariance forward.

Using the carried VAR, compute the Pesaran-Shin generalized forecast-error variance decomposition at an eight-quarter forecast horizon, using moving-average horizons zero through seven and the full innovation covariance. Row-normalize the resulting decomposition. Report the complete 4-by-4 matrix in percent, with each requested name read as source-to-target, plus the maximum absolute normalized row-sum residual and the Diebold-Yilmaz total connectedness index. Explain the distinction between generalized shares and orthogonalized Cholesky shares and the interpretive scope of the row normalization.

From the carried row-normalized decomposition, for each node report directional connectedness received from other nodes and transmitted to other nodes, and compute transmitted minus received net connectedness. Select the greatest net transmitter, ties in the stated node order. Also identify the largest off-diagonal directed edge, ties by target order then source order, and report source, target, and share. Identify every reported node using exactly one lower-case token from usd, eur, jpy, or ofr. Interpret the network direction and discuss what these inferred spillovers establish about transmission and causality.

Shock the carried net-transmitter node by one positive innovation standard deviation and compute its Pesaran-Shin generalized impulse response over horizons zero through eight using the full carried innovation covariance. Report the shock node using the same exact lower-case node token, its size, OFR-FSI impact response, the earliest horizon with greatest absolute OFR response and its signed value, cumulative responses over all nine horizons for each ordered node, and the horizon-eight OFR response. Explain how correlated contemporaneous innovations affect a generalized impulse response and the evidentiary limits of interpreting this estimated shock response as a forecast or policy experiment.
